Supported Sports

Source: R/sdvplotR-package.R
supported_sports.Rd

Returns the sport identifiers accepted by the sport argument of every sdvplotR function.

Usage

supported_sports()

Value

A character vector: "nfl", "nba", "wnba", "mlb", "nhl", "cfb" (college football), "mbb" (men's college basketball) and "wbb" (women's college basketball).

Examples

supported_sports()
#> [1] "nfl"  "nba"  "wnba" "mlb"  "nhl"  "cfb"  "mbb"  "wbb"
